name: contingent_tutoring_novel_transfer
persona: A learner who needs contingent support before independently transferring a concept.
description: A misconception triggers bounded scaffolding, followed by a novel transfer and delayed independent recovery.

pending_question.question: What does a loop invariant need to establish before the first iteration?

turns.content: What must a loop invariant establish before the first iteration?
It only needs to become true after the loop has run once.
For a sum loop, total equals the sum of the items already processed, including when zero items have been processed.
In a new partitioning loop, every element before boundary is less than the pivot and every element from boundary to the scan index has not been classified yet.
Three days later, for a maximum scan, best is the maximum of exactly the elements processed before the current index.

rubric: support is contingent on the misconception and fades after a successful attempt
the partitioning answer is evaluated as a novel transfer rather than familiar recall
the delayed maximum-scan answer receives no unnecessary reteaching
turn_rubrics: give one targeted scaffold for the initialization misconception
fade support and ask for one analogous production
recognize successful novel transfer without claiming durable mastery
treat the delayed independent production as retrieval evidence
